subject: SIG evidence request — Neptune Labs: architecture screenshots + runbooks

From: Lara Greene <lara.greene@neptune-labs.com>
To: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: security@neptune-labs.com
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG follow-up and evidence request for Neptune Labs

Hi Rishi,

Thanks for the SIG spreadsheet. Our security team has a few follow-ups on evidence that we need to complete internal review:

- High-level network topology screenshot (showing public/private subnets, KMS scope)
- Access runbook for incident response (PDF we can attach to our tracker)
- Screenshots showing IAM role audit logs (last 30 days) and retention settings
- The completed SIG answers export (we received a partial export earlier)

Can you share a downloadable bundle (Drive link + one-click zip) or individual files? Our procurement team will also need a copy for the vendor file.

Target: we'd like to have these by next Monday (Aug 30). Let me know if that's feasible.

Best,
Lara Greene
Security Lead, Neptune Labs

Cc: monica.patel@redwood.com, aditya.rao@redwood.com

Hi Lara — thanks for the note.

Short answer: yes, we can get you the topology screenshot, runbook PDF, IAM audit screenshots, and the completed SIG export. I'm looping in Monica (CS) and Aditya (security liaison) to pull the artifacts.

Questions:
- Do you need the network diagram at a particular DPI or format (PNG vs PDF)?
- For the IAM audit, do you want raw log CSVs or highlighted screenshots showing the retention configuration?

We'll aim to deliver a Drive folder with a zipped bundle for procurement by COB Aug 29 so you have time to review before Aug 30. If anything slips, I'll flag it immediately.

Thanks,
